title: Star Raid (One Star, One Seat)
positive_global_styles: energetic chiptune synths with live band
punchy drums, driving bass, bright electric guitar
clear, cheerful female lead vocal, crisp diction, every word intelligible

sections.section_name: Verse 1 - the lobby and the sponsor
lines: Open up the lobby, the next raid's on the way
A sponsor builds a wall of tokens, sets the price to pay
A prize in USDC is waiting at the top
The countdown's ticking, ticking, and it's never gonna stop
Bring your Lil Star, that's your seat
One Star, one seat, the bots get beat
Set it up once, then just one tap
Every hit's a real buy on Kuru, one and all
Capped at the price, the leftovers come back
Together we raid on Monad, fast track!
Pyth rolls the dice, the end block shows
Hits before it count, the rest don't score
Hit the target, watch the wall break down
The seats split the prize, the Stars take the crown
One Star, one seat, one wall
Grab a seat at Star Raid!
